description: Run a program with saved secrets in its environment. Their values are replaced with [hidden VAR] in the output, so you can use a secret without seeing it. A "totp" field gives its current 2FA code. Example: {"command": ["sh", "-c", "curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer $KEY\" https://api.example.com/me"], "secrets": {"KEY": "Example/api key"}}

command.description: The program and its arguments. Use ["sh", "-c", "…"] for shell syntax, and refer to secrets as $VAR inside it.

secrets.description: Environment variables to set, each from "<name>/<field>", like {"STRIPE_KEY": "Stripe/key"}

name: run_with_secrets
title: Run a command with secrets
